data_mode.note: Streamed and filtered at ingest; see src/ingest/download.py

gate_g3.criterion: Spearman >= 0.60 AND share-growth capture >= 1.05x volume AND median base volume of the selected list >= 25% of the volume rule's (anti-gaming guard)
gate_g3.note: Absolute-growth capture is reported but is NOT a pass condition. Volume ranking wins it mechanically, and with no call data in the holdout the back-test cannot separate captured growth from growth that would have occurred regardless.

challenger_verdict.note: share-capture win driven by small denominators, not persuadability

recommendation.criterion: highest share-growth capture among ['opportunity', 'volume', 'hybrid'] with absolute-growth capture >= 90% of the volume rule's

call_response_fit.identified_from: Open Payments food-and-beverage events naming the focus brand (rep-visit proxy)
call_response_fit.caveat: Observational. Volume-decile stratification removes the dominant confounder but reps still select within a stratum on information the model cannot see. Treat the ceiling as an UPPER BOUND.
call_response_fit.reason: no detectable dose-response: fit sits on a parameter bound (ceiling 0.0000, half-saturation 60.0) with weighted R^2 -0.096

headline_h3.cap_basis: one recruiting cycle (1.5x current force); the model's unconstrained answer is not executable
headline_h3.label: NOT IDENTIFIED -- public data show no measurable call response; headcount held, break-even response reported, pilot recommended. Break-even and sensitivity shown use the config ASSUMPTIONS and are illustrative only.

retargeting_value.priced_at: break-even response (the response at which today's force exactly pays)
retargeting_value.label: MODELLED -- prices each list's modelled opportunity at the break-even response (the response at which today's force exactly pays). Ranking on opportunity maximises modelled opportunity by construction; validate against the realised-growth back-test before quoting.

gate_g2.criterion: at least 30% of in-market prescribers move 2+ deciles between the volume and opportunity rankings

ds_conformal.structure: two-part: P(still writes the brand) x conformal interval given that
ds_conformal.production_variant: marginal conformal, conditional on still writing

ds_causal.reading: association, quantified -- the pilot remains the causal test

ds_uplift.reading: observational; ranks where promotion is associated with movement

ds_explain.replica: XGBoost reg:quantileerror, same features, tau and year

ds_ablation.prospective_test: tau 0.50 and national achievable share, scored on the 2025 refresh

ds_network.source: CMS Doctors and Clinicians National Downloadable File
ds_network.caveat: current enrolment snapshot applied to 2022-2024 behaviour; biases peer effects toward zero

ds_ceiling.reading: count noise is negligible at this budget: the gap between the rules and hindsight is behaviour change no administrative dataset records

ds_placebo.reading: the estimate survives randomisation and rises with dose, but about half of it also appears for unrelated companies' meals: read the brand-specific effect as the lower end of the range; the pilot remains the causal test
